python3 << 'EOF'
import statistics

# FY 1961-1967 computed interest charged values (in millions)
y = [8769, 9534, 10141, 10931, 11488, 12533, 12972]
t = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]  # t=0 in FY 1961

# Calculate OLS
n = len(t)
t_mean = sum(t) / n
y_mean = sum(y) / n

# Slope = sum((t-t_mean)*(y-y_mean)) / sum((t-t_mean)^2)
numerator = sum((t[i] - t_mean) * (y[i] - y_mean) for i in range(n))
denominator = sum((t[i] - t_mean)**2 for i in range(n))
slope = numerator / denominator

# Intercept = y_mean - slope * t_mean
intercept = y_mean - slope * t_mean

print(f"Slope: {slope}")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept}")

# Predict FY 1968 (t = 7)
t_1968 = 7
forecast_1968 = slope * t_1968 + intercept
print(f"\nForecast FY 1968: {forecast_1968}")

# Actual FY 1968 value
actual_1968 = 15426
print(f"Actual FY 1968: {actual_1968}")

# Forecast error = Forecast - Actual
forecast_error = forecast_1968 - actual_1968
print(f"\nForecast error: {forecast_error}")
print(f"Rounded to nearest hundredths: {round(forecast_error, 2)}")
EOF
